primary_task: B1 — grade II–IV aGvHD by day +100 from the day +7 draw (issued day +9); Level 2: leave-centre-out across >= 20 centres; Level 1C: temporal split at one institution
primary_metric: IPCW time-dependent AUROC at day 100, competing risks = death and relapse
baselines_to_beat: MAGIC MAP (ST2+REG3a day-7 algorithm) + clinical covariates
gradient-boosted trees on 20-40 registry variables (tuned, same splits)

level2_gate.ci_method: centre-level t-interval, K-1 d.f. (not a percentile bootstrap)
level2_gate.rationale: interval method, margin and centre count are fixed by the operating characteristics computed in section 8.12

level1c_single_centre.split: temporal: earliest 60 % of transplants for development, latest 40 % for test (600 test patients at 1,500)
level1c_single_centre.interval: paired DeLong 95 % interval of the AUROC difference on the temporal test set
level1c_single_centre.max_head_parameters: from the Riley criteria for the development set (about 14 at 900 patients, AUROC 0.72, prevalence 0.35)

level3_additional.min_n: computed per task by riley_n(P, target AUROC, prevalence) and validation_n (section 9.7)

stopping_rule: if Level 1 is not reached on B1 at stage-1 scale, publish the negative result and do not proceed to stage 3
